question: Could runtimeIsStreaming=false on a pre-terminal cached stream_resume retire the stream and permanently drop subsequent live terminal frames?
observedTestFact: Parent reports original r06_chat_wire resume failure last event.isStreaming Null!=false after exact contiguous sequence and -FINAL text assertions already passed. This is not proof of missing final text. Original d failure must remain recorded.
backendAnalysis: observe_run polls stored events every5ms independently of run active state; DB active empty does not mean all events projected to ChatWire cache

resume queries active DB then locks streams; projection final handler publishes assistant_run_end and status(false) through separate publish lock acquisitions, so resume can legally see terminal DB with intermediate cached prefix
Original test waits DB active empty and immediately requires cached events last status(false); it lacks actual projection-complete precondition
frontendAnalysis: runtimeIsStreaming=false controls applyStreamingStatus(false,force), which removes streamingSessions/activeSessionStreams only
That path does not retire SessionStreamMeta.admission, reset consumed sequence evidence or call streamBufferManager.finishRun
Live same-stream continuous delta/end/status still pass updateSessionStreamMeta/StreamAdmission; runtime=false is not an admission rejection input
Status handler intentionally never begins/finishes/finalizes run; actual run_end owns buffer finalization
On reset/truncated/non-incremental rebuild, live frames may be held during HTTP hydrate, but intermediate msg.isStreaming=true causes a second requestStreamResume after hydration to recover them
These observations assume normal valid identity/continuous stream and successful existing recovery transport; no claim all network failures are solved
conclusion: No deterministic product tail-loss path identified from runtimeIsStreaming=false alone. Establishing actual same-session/same-stream WS terminal status within original timeout before asserting complete final replay tail is a valid fixture precondition fix, not itself a product implementation fix.
necessaryMinimalConsumerRegression: Feed actual handleServerMessage an intermediate same-stream resume with runtimeIsStreaming=false/isStreaming=true and no final status; then actual subsequent same-stream run_end/status (and valid remaining text frames if prefix before them). Assert complete displayed content, sequence progression, accepted terminal frames and cleared busy state

For reset/rebuild path delay actual message hydration while terminal live frame arrives, then verify second resume requested and terminal content/status recovered; do not only inject final status into store
